body.label: Trigger
body.html: An ally within 3 units is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Become the target instead if eligible. If you do, the original ally becomes Rallied after the Action resolves.

surges.html: One affected ally becomes Rallied after the triggering effect resolves.
If an enemy triggered this Reaction, it becomes Exposed if it ignores you on its next Action.
